metric_scope.weights: parameter-count-derived float32 storage; excludes gradients, optimizer state, activations, runtime, and any OS overhead
metric_scope.flops: estimated forward operations per example from the benchmark model dimensions
metric_scope.communication: simulated tensor payload bytes; excludes protocol and network overhead
metric_scope.wall_clock: local CPU simulation run time with client training executed in affinity-limited worker processes; excludes shared pool startup, and is not physical-device or network latency
metric_scope.client_training_seconds: per-device local model construction, data-loader setup, and local training duration; excludes inter-process serialization and aggregation
metric_scope.inference: paired confidence intervals are descriptive; this scaling sweep is exploratory and does not establish non-inferiority
